title: Critique: seeing and confidence in seeing vary independently

statements.text: In exclusion experiments subjects see a flashed word or part of it with low confidence and no higher-order state that would lead to a report, and signal detection models show that seeing and confidence in having seen vary independently.

sources.quote: This provides another piece of empirical evidence against the higher-order point of view.
consciously seeing the stimulus and confidence that one has seen it can vary independently
